hooks.text: 波次间外出搜集资源与建材，并遭遇竞技场、宝箱基地和巡逻队事件
hooks.excerpt: Between waves, take advantage of the downtime to gather valuable resources. Find power-ups to craft a devastating build for your Kritter Collect building materials to upgrade your defenses Encounter random events across 3 different procedurally generated levels According to the Manual, we're going to need resources to craft ramparts, turrets, and traps to facilitate our survival. It also advises staying alert, as certain events might occur during exploration: arena fights, bases containing upgrade chests, patrols offering gold and resources...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 敌潮抵达前必须赶回飞船，以四职业搭配墙、陷阱和炮塔防守
hooks.excerpt: Anticipate incoming enemies and make it back to M. Ark in time Fight using one of 4 classes (Defender, Tracker, Engineer, and Ninja) Build defenses (walls, traps, turrets…)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 时间回溯会清空局内强化，唯有灵魂水晶保留并购买永久设施
hooks.excerpt: All run-based upgrades are temporary and disappear at the end of the run… all except Soul Crystals! No worries, it happens to the best of us. M. Ark will simply trigger a temporal rewind. All your upgrades will be lost except your Soul Crystals Use them to unlock permanent upgrades: a radar, a merchant, a second wall row… and much more
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
